components.name: Directory navigation
components.description: Underlined native navigation with keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-directory-link { display: inline-block; color: #202020; padding-block: 0.625rem; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 0.25em; } .ds-directory-link:hover { text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-directory-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #202020; outline-offset: 5px; }

components.description: An existing concept with a version number, name, description, and ordinary link.

components.css: .ds-concept-list { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-concept-entry { padding: clamp(1.25rem, 4vw, 2rem); border: 1px solid #d9d9d9; background: #ffffff; color: #202020; } .ds-concept-entry h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-concept-entry p { max-width: 65ch; margin: 0.5rem 0 0; color: #595959; } .ds-concept-entry a { color: inherit; text-underline-offset: 0.25em; } .ds-concept-entry a:hover { text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-concept-entry a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #202020; outline-offset: 5px; }

narrative.overview: The hub uses simple system typography, neutral colors, and a single responsive column to introduce and organize concepts. The directory is the focus; it lists existing, independently designed concepts.

rules.name: Scope rule
rules.body: This document and the root stylesheet apply only to the hub. Every future concept gets an independent DESIGN.md, identity, and build method. The hub is not a visual starter for those concepts.

dos: Do keep the introduction short and the directory easy to find.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, semantic headings, and readable text contrast.
Do add concept links only after their real pages exist.
donts: Don't apply this hub's design tokens or components to concept versions.
Don't invent Monolith application claims or present unfinished concepts as available.
